punchline: In Brené Brown's surveys, people could name on average only three emotions as they felt them.
thirty_sec: Brené Brown's team surveyed about 7,000 people over five years and found they could name, on average, three emotions as they felt them: happiness, sadness, anger. Her Atlas of the Heart answers with a map of 87, grouped into 13 places you can go to. The point is to look for the exact word instead of the nearest one.
